sources: https://www.trrcc.org/ (Table Rock Camp & Retreat Center, the operator; tablerockcamp.org redirects here)
https://www.campspot.com/park/creekside-campground-at-table-rock-pickens-sc (Campspot park record via its consumer API, read in a browser)

values.note: 22 sites running parallel to the creek, each with water and electric hookups (new in 2019); RV and tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.trrcc.org/ ('Running parallel to the creek bed is our 22 site campground. Each site is equipped with brand new (2019) water and electric hook ups.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouses close to the sites; the laundry room in the bathhouse is open 24/7.

facilities.source: https://www.trrcc.org/ ('There is also a dump station located nearby. The bathhouses and picnic shelter are both in close walking distance to the campground.') + Campspot terms ('The laundry room, located in the bathhouse, is open 24/7'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on Campspot. Cancellations 48+ hours ahead cost $15, later $30. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon; late arrivals call for instructions. Stays of a month or longer need a signed agreement.

booking.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/creekside-campground-at-table-rock-pickens-sc (cancellation policy; terms: 'Check in is at 2 PM', 'Check out time is 12 PM', 'If you are staying in our park for a month or longer, we require an agreement to be signed') + https://www.trrcc.org/ ('reserve today!'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $30 a night for an RV site ($20 tent), the same on the operator's page and on Campspot (October 2026, January and June 2027, Tuesday and Saturday alike, read 2026-10-13). Plus the park's $3 'Booking Fee' once per stay; Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout.

fees.source: https://www.trrcc.org/ ('Rental Cost: RVs- $30/night, Tents- $20/night'), read 2026-10-21 + Campspot pricing read 2026-10-13 (campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl)

note: The campground of Table Rock Camp & Retreat Center, a non-profit Wesleyan Church camp beside Table Rock State Park in the Blue Ridge foothills; the sites run along a creek, with views of Table Rock. --Claude
summary: Operator (Table Rock Camp & Retreat Center) and Campspot confirm $30 RV sites, water+electric hookups, dump station, laundry, Campspot booking. Added 22 sites and booking terms. Note trimmed (laundry hours moved to facilities.note). Hookups (50A + water, from Campspot 2026-10-13) left as is; no sewer stated. Not stated: max rig length, season.
